clusters.name: Arthur's death
clusters.reason: Arthur died in June 1998; Owen's college year came apart over the next months and Edna's first cancer followed within a year.

clusters.name: Tessa, then the separation
clusters.reason: A new partner in 2005 and the separation in mid-2006, with two of the shifts that count, fewer than three.

clusters.name: Edna's illness and death
clusters.reason: Edna's illness from about 2008 to her death in February 2011, with Owen's moves, the breakup and his distance from his parents in the same years.

clusters.name: Iris's and Harold's deaths
clusters.reason: Iris died at the end of 2014; within seven months Owen could not talk with his mother, shut her out and left.
